landing.title: Everything your club plays, in one place.
landing.subtitle: Ranking, club nights and tournaments, from the results members log on their phones. Free for players, and no app store.
landing.altHero: PoolClubs on a laptop, a tablet and phones: the club directory, a tournament bracket and the daily ranking
landing.altRanking: The overall ranking screen on a large display
landing.altDrill: A drill with its table diagram and scoring
landing.tourTitle: This is what it looks like
landing.tourBody: Four screens of the app as it is, not mockups.
landing.t1Body: You set the tournament up, people enter, and every result pushes the winner into the next round. League, groups with a final bracket, or double elimination.
landing.t1Alt: A tournament with its podium and the bracket rounds below it
landing.t2Body: Fullscreen TV mode to leave running on the club's television: the matches in play and the day's table, with nobody having to touch anything.
landing.t2Alt: TV mode on a screen in a club, showing the scoreboards and the day's table
landing.t3Body: Their full history, their form over the last matches and the charts of how they have climbed. Every member has one.
landing.t3Alt: A player profile with their match history and progress charts
landing.t4Body: A page that shows the club, its tournaments and its latest results, with the map and the opening hours. The internal ranking stays between members.
landing.t4Alt: A club's public page with its map, its opening hours and its results
landing.whoTitle: Three different clubs, one shared problem
landing.whoBody: One person keeps the standings, in a spreadsheet only that person ever opens. The day they get tired of it, the league stops.
landing.whoATitle: Affiliated club with an internal league
landing.whoAToday: The standings live in a spreadsheet one member keeps, and there is an argument every month.
landing.whoANow: An Elo ranking that updates itself, and tournament brackets that fill in as results go in.
landing.whoBTitle: Pool hall or bar with tables
landing.whoBToday: Tuesdays and Wednesdays with the tables idle, and regulars who come and go.
landing.whoBNow: A reason to come back midweek: open challenges, the ranking on the screen behind the bar, and a listing on the map.
landing.whoCTitle: Whoever organises everything inside the club
landing.whoCToday: They end up keeping the results, sorting the fixtures and taking the complaints.
landing.whoCNow: They create the club, they are the admin and they approve who joins. The repetitive work is the app's.
landing.startTitle: From nothing to a ranking in one night
landing.startBody: Nothing big has to be decided. Record one Thursday's matches and look at what comes out the next morning.
landing.s1Body: Tell us its name and where it plays. We set it up and hand it to you, usually the same day.
landing.s2Body: Every club gets its own link and code. Paste it in the club's WhatsApp group or print it next to the tables.
landing.s3Body: Everyone enters their own result from their phone, at the table, as each game ends.
landing.s4Title: Look at the table the next day
landing.s4Body: The Elo is already recalculated and the history stops getting lost. If it does not win you over, you have lost nothing.
landing.approveBody: Whoever asks for the club is its admin. Join requests arrive one by one and you approve them, so the internal ranking never opens up to strangers.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything the club argues about, in one place
landing.featuresBody: This is what a member finds inside the first time they sign in.
landing.f1Body: Every result moves the table, and nobody has to maintain it.
landing.f1a: Overall ranking and daily ranking, so one good night counts for something too.
landing.f1b: By division or combined, with each player's form over their last matches.
landing.f1c: TV mode, to leave it up on the screen in the venue.
landing.f2Body: Recorded at the table, as it happens, with nothing written on paper.
landing.f2a: Singles or doubles, 8, 9 or 10 ball, counting the racks won.
landing.f2b: Open challenges to any member: send it, accept it, record the result.
landing.f2c: History filtered by player and by division, with reactions and comments.
landing.f3Body: The three formats a club actually runs, designed by people who have run tournaments.
landing.f3a: League, groups with a final bracket, and double elimination.
landing.f3b: With the option to switch to single elimination from whichever round you choose.
landing.f3c: Different race lengths for the semis and the final, and walkovers when somebody does not turn up.
landing.f4Body: What separates a club from a room with tables: people who get better.
landing.f4a: A drill library, each one with its table diagram, its difficulty and the skill it trains.
landing.f4b: Personal training plans, built from what each player keeps missing.
landing.f4c: Progress charts per drill, so you can tell whether the practice is paying off.
landing.f5Body: What somebody who is not a member yet gets to see, and today sees of you nowhere.
landing.f5a: A public club page with its tournaments and latest results, and the club on the map.
landing.f5b: Public player profiles and a search box, so people find you from Google.
landing.f5c: The internal ranking and the challenges stay between approved members.
landing.f6Body: Whoever asked for it runs it, and the app wears your colour.
landing.f6a: Invitations by link or by code, and every join request approved one at a time.
landing.f6b: You can add the members up front: each one claims their name on joining and keeps their matches.
landing.f6c: Your own club logo and ball colour, which repaints the whole app.
landing.a1: Players never pay. For the club it is free during the beta; later there will be a per-club fee, announced in advance.
landing.q2: Does anything have to be downloaded?
landing.a2: No. It opens in the browser and gets added to the home screen like any other app, with no store involved.
landing.q3: What about matches and members from previous years?
landing.a3: The member list can be added before anyone is invited, along with whatever matches you want to load. Each player claims their name on joining and keeps what was already recorded.
landing.q4: Who can see the club ranking?
landing.a4: You decide. The public page shows the club, its tournaments and its latest results; the internal ranking and the challenges stay between approved members.
landing.a5: Whoever asked for the club is the admin: they approve join requests, edit players, set up tournaments and can remove anyone who needs removing.
landing.a6: Spanish, English and French, and each member picks their own. There is a light theme and a dark one too.
landing.q7: Does it tell us anything, or do we have to keep checking?
landing.a7: Notifications arrive when somebody challenges you, when a tournament opens and when a new drill is added.
landing.q8: And if it does not win us over?
landing.a8: You have lost nothing. It is one night of recorded matches and a club you can stop using whenever you like.
landing.q9: What if my club is already in the directory?
landing.a9: It may well be: the Spanish federated clubs are listed from their own federations' rosters. Find yours, open its page and claim it. We transfer the club to you and from then on you run it.
landing.installIosBody: Open in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
landing.installAndroidBody: Open in Chrome, tap the menu, then Install app.
landing.installDesktopBody: Click the install icon in the address bar, or just use it in a tab.
landing.storeSoon: Native iOS and Android apps are on the way.
landing.finalBody: Add your club, invite the regulars, record tonight's matches.
landing.ctaNote: Free for players, and free for your club through the beta. It runs in the browser and installs to your home screen.
